_about: Protocol metadata from Lester's '1 - How to upload Protocols to the portal' (19 Oct 2026). Copy exactly. status 'approved' = members see it; 'pending' = only the expert sees it. The importer finds each folder under --root by the Protocol title, so the parent folder name does not matter.

protocols.title: The Weight & Wellness Service Line Protocol
protocols.description: Add a medical weight program your patients trust, run it like real care, and grow the whole practice with it.

protocols.title: The Subscription Practice Protocol
protocols.description: Automate recurring programs, keep the patient relationship, and build revenue that covers the bills.

protocols.title: The Value-First Membership Protocol
protocols.description: Compete on value, not price: memberships patients understand, plans they commit to, and long-time patients who stay.

protocols.title: The Team Follow-Through Protocol
protocols.description: Intake that qualifies, recommendations without the sales pitch, and a team that follows up every day.

protocols.title: The Retail Gap Protocol
protocols.description: Build retail into every step from booking to checkout, and a team that recommends because it cares.

protocols.title: The Owner Step-Back Protocol
protocols.description: Get out of the treatment room without your revenue crashing: delegate, document, take CEO hours, and build a practice no single provider can take with them.

protocols.title: The Technology Decision Protocol
protocols.description: Decide on new devices and treatments with data, not hype: check the real costs, ask people you trust, know your team and patients, and never rush to be first.

protocols.title: The Trust-First Consultation Protocol
protocols.description: Earn trust fast, hear what patients really want, say no when you should, and price so the plan never bends to the margin.

protocols.title: The Signature Niche Protocol
protocols.description: Pick the thing you'll be known for, get it out there, and build the marketing team you can't do without.

protocols.title: The Human-Touch Tech Stack Protocol
protocols.description: Build a tech stack that feels like your brand: find where patients get lost, use AI on purpose, and bring your team with you.

protocols.title: The AI Front Desk Protocol
protocols.description: Answer every lead first, and keep people where people matter.

protocols.title: The Next-Visit Protocol
protocols.description: Memberships and consultations that bring patients back, not bargain hunters.

_owner_packs_about: Expert-only or company-only downloads (never members). 'folder_match' is a folder name fragment searched under --root; 'file_match' picks single files instead.
_company_page_about: Shown on the public company page once the company is approved and verified.
